final: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS FLOAT) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) as rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.MediaTypeId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.Name), mean_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) as avg_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT mr.Name, mr.rate, mr.rate / mean_rate.avg_rate as normalized_rate FROM media_rates mr CROSS JOIN mean_rate ORDER BY mr.Name
